description: NetWasmMvc SDK — ASP.NET MVC runtime for WebAssembly with production-scoped hybrid routing. Controllers, Views, SignalR, EF Core SQLite, and Identity support are bundled; security-sensitive Identity flows can be marked server-authoritative instead of running in the browser capsule. Powered by Cepha (Physarum polycephalum).
releaseNotes: v2.0.44: fixes regenerated cpoly Identity.UI internals by keeping Identity.UI compiled Razor pages registered as compiled page types, enabling the Bootstrap5 view-version provider for compiled partial paths, and completing Manage/2FA fallback rendering so EnableAuthenticator and dot-segment ForgotPasswordConfirmation routes render correctly from fresh carriers. v2.0.43 introduced canonical Identity/Area route normalization.
